1. Connect the OBD-II Wi-Fi cable to the OBD-II connector of your car (usually it is under the steering wheel). Start the car engine and wait for the green light on the Wi-Fi device.
2. On your iPhone device, go to Settings, select connect to a Wi-Fi network.

After connecting to Wi-Fi, go to advanced settings:

Set
IP Address: Static.
IP Address: 192.168.0.11
Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0
Choose a device name for Wi-Fi
Exit settings.
3. Go to the inCarDoc application> Settings, where configure the following:
IP Address: 192.168.0.10
Port: 35000
Click “Save”
4. Start the engine. View vehicle parameters.

You could help to improve the project by sending OBD2 details info related to your car. Fill in the car details with the configuration screen and click the send button in "General information" section.
